list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run_id AS __value, strategy || ' ' || symbol || ' ' || run_id AS __text FROM runs ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 100

list.name: compare
list.label: Compare runs
list.query: SELECT run_id AS __value, strategy || ' ' || symbol || ' ' || run_id AS __text FROM runs ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", equity, series AS metric FROM equity_curve WHERE run_id = '$run' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Compare runs (rebased to 100)
panels.description: Pick runs in the 'Compare runs' dropdown; every curve is normalized to 100 at its start so different capital bases and dates overlay cleanly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ec.ts AS "time", ec.equity / first_value(ec.equity) OVER (PARTITION BY ec.run_id ORDER BY ec.ts) * 100 AS equity, r.strategy || ' ' || r.symbol || ' (' || ec.run_id || ')' AS metric FROM equity_curve ec JOIN runs r ON r.run_id = ec.run_id WHERE ec.run_id IN (${compare:sqlstring}) AND ec.series = 'strategy' ORDER BY ec.ts

SELECT c.symbol, r.strategy, r.sharpe, r.total_return_pct, r.spy_return_pct, r.max_drawdown_pct, r.trades, c.promoted, c.note, c.run_id FROM champions c JOIN runs r ON r.run_id = c.run_id ORDER BY c.symbol

SELECT created, run_id, strategy, symbol, total_return_pct, benchmark_return_pct, spy_return_pct, max_drawdown_pct, sharpe, trades, win_rate, regime_filter, halted FROM runs ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 50
